summary: Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing that it entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger on September 27, 2026, by and among the Company, Lifecore Inc. (Parent), and Hazel Merger Sub, Inc., affiliates of Webster Equity Partners. The agreement provides that Merger Sub will merge into Lifecore, with Lifecore surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. Each share of common stock converts into the right to receive $6.28 per share in cash, without interest plus one contingent value right per share. Series A Preferred Stock receives the Conversion Amount specified in the Certificate of Designations. The CVR represents the right to receive Milestone Payment Amounts, if any, when and if actually payable, under a Contingent Value Rights Agreement to be entered into at or prior to the Effective Time. The filing describes mechanics and structural terms; specific premium percentages, aggregate transaction valuation, and a financing summary are not included in the excerpt. What to watch: timing of the definitive proxy, satisfaction of closing conditions, and details of the CVR milestones and any financing contingencies.
